evals.prompt: Write a commit message for this staged diff. evals.expected_output: A Conventional Commits subject matching the repo style: type fix, scope auth, imperative verb, 72 characters or fewer, no trailing period. assertions: Subject is 72 characters or fewer with no trailing period
No body for a self-explanatory change
No first person and no file narration
Output is a single code block
